extra_rule: Below the attachment8 reference threshold, assume intensity grade zero in both modalities. At or above threshold, no 1-6 point grade can be inferred from a threshold alone.
parent_rule: Diagnostic only: separately ranked panel marginals are not raw-card intensities; do not clip children to parent and silently change the scoring definition.
scope: One primary52 scorecard view: 50 panel-relative estimates plus two separately identified chemical-threshold scenarios. No original-card absolute calibration claim, no crowd-to-panel label substitution, no new predictive model family.
